depictions.name: Temple of Artemis Laphria
depictions.text: The Temple of Artemis Laphria was a temple dedicated to the goddess Artemis in Patrai, Greece. It was located next to the Temple of Zeus. During the Peloponnesian War, the temple was visited by the misthios Kassandra, who killed the guards and looted the temple's treasures.
